name: weather.get_weather
description: Get current weather conditions, hourly forecasts, or daily forecasts for any location using Google Weather API

location.description: City name, address, or 'current location' (e.g., 'Dallas', 'Dallas, TX', 'McKinney, Texas')

forecast_type.description: Type of weather info: 'current' (now), 'hourly' (next hours), 'daily' (next days). Default: current

hours.description: For hourly: number of hours to forecast (1-240). Default: 6

days.description: For daily: number of days to forecast (1-10). Default: 3
